chunks: Yet they say: 'When will this promise come to pass, if you speak the truth?'
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers ask the prophets about the timing of the promised punishment?
ai.summary: This verse captures the impatient skepticism of the disbelievers who demand a specific timeline for the promised resurrection, often using it to mock the prophets' message. In Shia exegesis, this reflects the human tendency to doubt the unseen (ghayb) and serves as a reminder that divine timing is precise yet beyond immediate human comprehension, reinforcing the need for steadfast faith (iman) despite apparent delays.
